_what: Routed map edits recording the MEASURED coverage limits of the EMC surfaceome instrument, including the CSPG4 coverage gap. Reasoning: research/manuscripts/ofcs-var2csa-lane.md §3.
_rule: B2's `current_text` is verbatim from the live file, count == 1. B1 and B3 are JSON list APPENDS and carry `proposed_text: null` -- the derived-count contract in route_map_edits.py -- because matching a file tail as an anchor is brittle and a silent mis-append into a graph file is worse than a deferred edit. Their payload is in `proposed_record`.
_not_applied_and_why: DRY RUN ONLY. systems/graph/** edits must be followed by `python3 systems/systems_check.py --write-views` in the same commit, and registering a new instrument changes a register three routes read.
_what_this_deliberately_does_NOT_do: It does NOT add INS-SURFACEOME-SCAN to any route's `instruments.support`. The instrument's control passes, so [V2] would permit it -- but which routes it SUPPORTS versus which it merely bounds is the route owners' call, and making it silently in a limits edit is how a coverage gap becomes an endorsement.

It does NOT add CSPG4 to SEED_SURFACE. That is the right fix and it is one line, but it invalidates emc-surfaceome-scan.json until the scan is re-run in CI, and every document quoting the gap must change in the same commit. test_surfaceome_instrument_limits.py fails loudly the moment somebody does it, which is the point.
It does NOT create a route for the ofCS lane. The expression read that would justify one is dispatched by another agent and is not in hand.
verified_against: the worktree checkout of this branch

map_edits_required.why: ⛔ THE REPOSITORY'S HEADLINE SURFACE-ANTIGEN NEGATIVE HAS NO INSTRUMENT ROW. emc_surfaceome_scan.py is registered as an ARTIFACT (ART-SURFACE-EXPRESSION) and as an instrument NOWHERE, so the register invariant -- 'an instrument that has never recovered a known answer cannot support a claim' -- has never been applied to it, in either direction. It HAS a two-sided known-answer control and passes it (housekeeping genes must be ABSENT from the surfaceome set: measured 0 leaked; CD276 must recover as broadly expressed: measured class_frac_expressed 0.98). Registering it is therefore not a demotion -- it makes a passing control visible AND attaches the five measured coverage limits to it, which is the half nothing currently carries.

proposed_record.name: EMC surfaceome discovery scan (DepMap surface-gene expression + selectivity)

known_answer_control.description: Two-sided, and both sides are in the artifact's own `self_validation`: housekeeping genes (ACTB, GAPDH) must be ABSENT from the surfaceome set or the surface filter is broken (measured: 0 leaked), AND a known broad surface marker (CD276/B7-H3) must recover as broadly expressed, reproducing depmap_target_expression's prior (measured: class_frac_expressed 0.98, class_frac_detectable 1.00).
known_answer_control.note: ⚠ THE CONTROL PASSING SAYS NOTHING ABOUT COVERAGE, AND COVERAGE IS WHERE THIS INSTRUMENT'S FAILURES ARE. Five limits are MEASURED in research/modalities/surfaceome-instrument-limits.json and asserted by research/modalities/tests/test_surfaceome_instrument_limits.py: (L1) the population is DepMap tumour cell lines in monoculture, so there is no stromal / CAF compartment an antigen could be counted in; (L2) LRRC15, a real sarcoma STROMAL ADC target, reads class_frac_expressed 0.00 -- the compartment's absence, not the antigen's; (L3) every gene of the CS/GAG sulfation machinery is excluded by the instrument's own UniProt plasma-membrane filter, so a glycan epitope such as oncofetal chondroitin sulfate cannot be ranked even indirectly; (L4) CSPG4 is in neither the seed nor any output -- and the founding VAR2CSA paper (PMID 26461094) NAMES two ofCS carrier proteoglycans, CD44 and CSPG4, of which this seed contains one. ⚠ "Names two" is not "there are two": Agerbæk et al., Nat Commun 2018 (PMC6095877 [FT]) puts the carrier repertoire at "more than 30 different proteoglycans", which weakens any single-carrier argument in BOTH directions and leaves only the coverage arithmetic standing; (L5) the single 'myxoid' line is ACH-001519, whose EMC identity was retracted 2026-08-05, so the scan holds NO EMC observation of anything. ⭐ The limit is NARROWER than 'cannot see stroma' and the narrow version is the true one: CD248 and PDGFRB are called stromal and both read selectivity_significant true, because mesenchymal tumour cells transcribe them. What it cannot see is a gene that ONLY the stroma expresses.

proposed_record.closure_note: Open and usable within its class. Its conclusion -- that the selective ∩ normal-tissue-restricted intersection is empty -- is a true statement about CLASSIC PROTEIN ANTIGENS RANKABLE FROM TUMOUR-CELL mRNA, and silent about glycans, stromal-only antigens and anything absent from its seed. Nothing in the artifact drew that boundary before 2026-08-07.
proposed_record.scope_note: ⛔ L4 IS THE CHEAPEST OPEN ITEM ON THIS INSTRUMENT AND IT IS ONE LINE: add CSPG4 and the proteoglycan module to SEED_SURFACE and re-run. ⚠ AND RECORD THE SCANNED GENE LIST WHILE DOING IT -- the artifact stores n_from_uniprot = 2820 and n_total = 2826 but NOT the members, and reports per-gene numbers for only ~110 distinct genes, so 'was CSPG4 scanned?' is currently UNDECIDABLE from the committed record rather than answered either way. That single omission is what turns a one-line fix into an unanswerable question.

map_edits_required.how_to_apply: ⛔ NOT a text replacement -- this is a JSON list APPEND and the router would have to match the file tail, which is brittle. `proposed_text` is deliberately null (the derived-count contract in route_map_edits.py): append `proposed_record` to systems/graph/instruments.json, then run `python3 systems/systems_check.py --write-views`, which regenerates systems/views/registers/instruments.md. Do NOT write `verifies`, `allocated_to` or `usable` -- all three are DERIVED and [X2] fails the build if they appear.

proposed_record.name: Measured coverage limits of the EMC surfaceome instrument
proposed_record.note: ⭐ Registered 2026-08-07. Turns two PROSE limits in emc-unexplored-treatment-lanes.md §0 into five measured, CI-asserted ones (research/modalities/tests/test_surfaceome_instrument_limits.py). ⚠ It has no known-answer control and needs none: it makes no prediction, and every field is a membership test or a field read on a committed file. ⛔ It deliberately answers 'was CSPG4 scanned?' as UNDECIDABLE rather than guessing -- the scan records the scanned set's SIZE and not its MEMBERS. What IS decidable is that no per-gene number for CSPG4 exists anywhere in the record, so the absence is a coverage gap and not a negative result.
